_about: Few-shot example for the film shot list (studio/story/filmkit.py). A made-up story, ABRIDGED to 10 shots to show the craft; real lists have 26-34 shots. Narration: 'A ship's cook threw the captain's lemons into the sea. The sailors cheered. Ten weeks later, their gums were bleeding. You see, it's like a phone that dies without its charger. Lemons were the charger.'

cast.cook: a chubby 40 year old ship's cook with a red bandana, a bushy ginger beard, a stained white apron over a striped blue shirt, 1780s
cast.captain: a tall thin 55 year old sea captain with a grey ponytail, a hooked nose, a navy blue coat with brass buttons and a black tricorn hat, 1780s

shots.name: throw
shots.prompt: medium shot, {cook} grinning and tossing a wooden crate of bright yellow lemons over the rail of an 18th century sailing ship, choppy sea, golden afternoon light
shots.motion: he swings the crate over the rail, lemons tumble, slow camera push in
shots.check: Is a man throwing lemons from a ship?

shots.name: splash
shots.prompt: close-up of yellow lemons splashing into dark green ocean waves beside a wooden hull, spray, golden light
shots.motion: lemons bob and sink in the waves, slow camera move down
shots.check: Are lemons falling into the sea?

shots.name: captain
shots.prompt: low angle, {captain} standing on the quarterdeck frowning, sails and rigging behind, golden light
shots.check: Is a man in a tricorn hat on a ship?

shots.name: cheer
shots.prompt: wide shot, a crowd of scruffy sailors on a ship deck raising their mugs and cheering, sunset sky
shots.motion: the sailors raise their mugs and laugh, slow camera move right

shots.name: weeks
shots.prompt: wide shot of a lonely sailing ship on a flat grey ocean under heavy clouds, cold light
shots.check: Is there a ship on the sea?

shots.name: gums
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a pale sweating sailor touching his sore mouth in a dim ship hold, a swinging lantern
shots.motion: he winces and touches his mouth, the lantern swings, slow camera push in
shots.check: Is a man touching his mouth?

shots.name: hold
shots.prompt: a dark ship hold full of sick sailors lying in hammocks, a single lantern, deep shadows

shots.name: phone
shots.prompt: close-up of a hand holding a modern phone with a black screen on a wooden table, cozy room, warm lamp light
shots.motion: the thumb taps the dark screen, slow camera push in
shots.check: Is a hand holding a phone?

shots.name: charger
shots.prompt: close-up of a phone charger cable lying beside a fresh yellow lemon on a wooden table, warm lamp light
shots.check: Is there a lemon next to a cable?

shots.name: end
shots.prompt: close-up, {cook} staring sadly at a single yellow lemon in his hand in a dark ship galley, candle light
shots.motion: he turns the lemon slowly in his fingers, slow camera push in
shots.check: Is a man holding a lemon?
